candidate_reports.remark: Dime-sized hail observed at Walmart in Murphy_ NC. Hail size measured by comparison to a U.S. dime coin.
Tree blown down onto powerlines south of Murphy.
Several trees down.
Delayed report: Three amateur radio stations_ trained spotters reported quarter size hail near the intersection of I75 and TN 320 in Chattanooga area.
Facebook image of a split tree with a partial lane blockage in East Ridge area.
Delayed report. WDEF live broadcast with tree and utility pole down on Georgia Ave.
Delayed Report: Inch of flowing water in Chattanooga.
Street flooding captured on Facebook video showing road flooding at a motel in East Ridge_ same location as last years flood event.
Several trees down.
At 515 PM_ EM reported 60+ weather related calls_ primarily floodwater related in Hamilton County. Had been 70+ calls the prior hour. Dispatch reported multiple flooding reports in Chattanooga_ East
Couple inches of floodwaters on Brainerd Road at what appeared to be the Chick-fil-a near Brainerd Park area. Facebook video from a secondhand person. Road still visible_ cars were driving through.
Facebook report of tree falling onto a house in Decatur.
Delayed report: At least 3 reports of downed trees in Tellico Plains.
Delayed report. Monroe County dispatch reports a few trees and utility poles down in Madisonville area. Time estimated by radar.
Brief power loss accompanying the hail.
Facebook report of marble sized hail at Blair & Old Harriman.
Numerous reports of trees down across county. 911 dispatch quoted they do not believe there was a single road without a tree down on it somewhere.
Several reports of trees down across Oak Ridge with Facebook pictures of multiple trees down. Multiple trees are on houses. Small hail also occurred during the strong winds.
Tree landed on a home in Oliver Springs resulting in an entrapment at the time.
Report from mPING: Dime (0.75 in.).
Report of small outbuilding blown over.
Carport partially collapsed on Nesper Road in Oak Ridge_ with large tree blown down in backyard.
Very large tree uprooted at the corner of Tennessee and Nesper. House also appears to have minor roof structural damage with damaged gutters.
Morgan County dispatch report numerous reports of downed trees and powerlines across county. Time estimated by radar.
Large tree branch down on Shetterly Road in Clinton.
Two separate Facebook reports of large hail in Clinton_ no ruler or measurement but both look to be at least quarter sized.
Facebook report of a fireworks tent collapsing in Maryville.
WVLT Facebook commenter reported very large tree branch down in backyard near Rocky Top.
County dispatch reports several trees down across portions of Campbell County_ time estimated by radar.
Report of a downed tree across Paint Rock Rd passed along by 911 dispatch center. Time estimated by radar.
Several trees down.

Reports of widespread trees down along Lee Highway_ Weaver Pike_ and several other roads in and around Bristol.
Dime-sized hail.
Severe trees down.
Reports of trees down along Interstate 81 near and east of Abingdon.
Corrects previous tstm wnd dmg report from 1 NNE Johnson City. Report of trees and large branches down in northern Johnson City near Interstate 26.
Report of winds consistent with a microburst in northern Johnson City. Large branches and trees down.
Several roadways with a good deal of water.
Several trees down.
